Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Reference attached letter dated 21.11.40,
from Passport Office, British Consulate-General,
Shanghai, requesting information concerning Mrs.
Clara Alekseevna Smith nee Verjehovesky, British
subject by marriage, enquiries disclosed that
she was born in Poland of Jewish parents, on
13.2.1900, and married a British subject, Percy
Arthur William Smith in the British Consulate-
General, Shanghai on 25.3.24. She was issued
British Passport No. 2356 on 4.12.24 and was registered
as British subject on 6.3.25.

Percy A.W. Smith was employed by Weeks & Co.,
Ltd. (not Hall & Holtz as stated in Special Branch
report dated 6.3.39) until 1929, when that firm went
into liquidation. Mrs. Smith appears to have left
Shanghai, shortly after her marriage, for Manila,
where she was connected with a night club for some
time, after which she is said to have gone to U.S.A.
It is believed that she returned to Shanghai about
1930, since which time she has been connected with
various houses of assignation and massage establishments.
She has at various times been employed as a dance
hostess in various low class cabarets and, in 1937,
was manageress of the Hungarian Restaurant, 272
Yu Yuen Road but was discharged for excessive
drinking. Later, she was manageress of Jack's Bar,
Yu Yuen Road, in conjunction with which a Chinese

日期：1940年12月8日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科 S. D. 9074）

事由：克拉拉·阿列克谢耶夫娜·史密斯夫人（Mrs. Clara Alekseevna Smith）——英国籍。

制作：警佐洛根（D.S.I. Logan） 转呈：督察克劳福德（D.I. Crawford）

参照附件中英国驻上海总领事馆护照处于1940年11月21日发出的信函，该函要求提供关于克拉拉·阿列克谢耶夫娜·史密斯夫人（娘家姓维尔热霍夫斯基，Verjehovesky，因婚姻取得英国国籍）的信息。经查，她于1900年2月13日出生于波兰，父母均为犹太人；1924年3月25日在上海英国总领事馆与英国公民珀西·阿瑟·威廉·史密斯（Percy Arthur William Smith）结婚。她于1924年12月4日获发英国护照第2356号，并于1925年3月6日注册为英国臣民。

珀西·A.W.史密斯受雇于威克斯有限公司（Weeks & Co., Ltd.）（而非1939年3月6日特务科报告中所述的霍尔与霍尔茨公司 Hall & Holtz），直至1929年该公司清算。史密斯夫人似乎在婚后不久即离开上海前往马尼拉，在那里她与一家夜总会有关联一段时间，随后据称去了美国。据信她于1930年左右返回上海，自此之后便与各类私会寓所和按摩院有所牵连。她曾先后在多家低级歌舞厅担任舞女领班，1937年曾任愚园路272号匈牙利餐厅（Hungarian Restaurant）的女经理，但因酗酒过度被解雇。后来，她成为愚园路杰克酒吧（Jack's Bar）的女经理，与该酒吧相关联的还有一家主要接待英军士兵的中国

by British troops.
    At the present time she is connected with
a massage establishment at the Paramount Building,
238 Yu Yuen Road and is a partner with Mrs.
Alexandra Ivanovna Mikhailova, Russian, in a house
of assignation kept by the latter at Flat No.202,
138 Nanking Road, Tel. No.10076. She has not
registered at the British Consulate since 5.3.25
and has not at any time reported the loss of her
British passport to the Police.
    Information from one source is to the effect
that her husband Percy A.W. Smith died in Shanghai
sometime before 1929 but no reference to his death
is contained in the vital statistics or cemeteries'
records of either the S.I.C. or F.M.C.
    Information from a former colleague is to
the effect that Smith returned to England several
years ago and has since died. This latter
information appears the most probable though it
has not been possible to obtain confirmation of it.

    目前，她与愚园路238号百乐门大楼（Paramount Building）的一家按摩院有关联，并与俄罗斯人亚历山德拉·伊万诺夫娜·米哈伊洛娃夫人（Mrs. Alexandra Ivanovna Mikhailova）合伙，后者在南京路138号202室经营一家私会寓所（电话：10076）。自1925年3月5日以来，她未在英國總領事館進行登記，也從未向警方報告其英國護照遺失。
    據一方消息稱，其丈夫珀西·A.W.史密斯於1929年前的某個時間在上海去世，但工部局（S.I.C.）或法公董局（F.M.C.）的人口統計或墓地記錄中均無其死亡記載。
    據一位前同事稱，史密斯數年前已返回英國並隨後去世。後一種說法似乎最為可信，儘管尚無法獲得證實。

参照附件中英国驻上海总领事馆护照处于1940年11月21日发出的信函，该函要求提供关于奥尔加·阿列克谢耶夫娜·史密斯夫人（娘家姓维尔热霍夫斯基，Verjehovsky，因婚姻取得英国国籍）的信息。经查，她于1900年2月13日出生于波兰，父母均为犹太人；1924年3月25日在上海英国总领事馆与英国公民珀西·阿瑟·威廉·史密斯（Percy Arthur William Smith）结婚。她于1924年12月4日获发英国护照第2256号，并于1925年3月6日注册为英国臣民。
珀西·A.W.史密斯受雇于威克斯有限公司（Weeks & Co., Ltd.）（而非1938年5月6日特务科报告中所述的霍尔与霍尔茨公司 Hall & Holts），直至1929年该公司清算。史密斯夫人似乎在婚后不久即离开上海前往马尼拉，在那里她与一家夜总会有关联一段时间，随后据称去了美国。据信她于1930年左右返回上海，自此之后便与各类私会寓所和按摩院有所牵连。她曾先后在多家低级歌舞厅担任舞女领班，1937年曾任愚园路272号匈牙利餐厅（Hungarian Restaurant）的女经理，但因酗酒过度被解雇。后来，她成为愚园路杰克酒吧（Jack's Bar）的女经理，与该酒吧相关联的还有一家中国

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL POLICE
SHANGHAI
S. B. REGISTRY
November 21st, 1939.
S. B. D. 96960.
9 / 12 40
Date

Dear Mr. Bennett,

I have received a visit from Mrs. Olga Alekseevna Smith, a British subject by marriage, who states she lost her passport about four months ago when her bag was snatched from her in Jessfield Park.

She gives her address 238 Yu Yuen Road and states she has returned to Shanghai in February this year.

According to our records she was born in Poland on 13th February 1900 and married Percy Arthur Wm. Smith at this Consulate-General on the 25th March, 1924, being issued Passport No. 2256 by this Consulate-General on the 4th December, 1924. She then registered as a British subject on the 6th March, 1925, but has not registered since.

On my asking her why she had not registered for 15 years, she informed me that she had been away from China "travelling" and had returned only this year. If so, the passport issued by us must have been replaced by another one, presumably issued elsewhere, as the one issued by us should have expired in 1934.

In view of the lapse of 15 years since this Consulate-General had any dealings with Mrs. Olga Smith and because of my own personal misgivings about her bona fides, I feel we should investigate her movements and find out whether she is still married to Smith and entitled to British nationality. Apparently she was employed at one time at Jock's Bar, Yu Yuen Road, and, I understand, was probably employed there last year. I have an impression that she is also attached to the "Paramount" this year. She calls herself an artist and confessed to me that she was running a "massage" business as it was difficult to get money.

/I

G. J. Bennett, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

尊敬的貝內特先生：

奧爾加·阿列克謝耶夫娜·史密斯夫人（因婚姻取得英國國籍）前來拜訪，稱約四個月前在極司菲爾公園（Jessfield Park）被人搶走手提包，導致護照遺失。

她提供的地址為愚園路238號，並稱今年二月已返回上海。

根據我方記錄，她於1900年2月13日出生於波蘭，1924年3月25日在本總領事館與珀西·阿瑟·威廉·史密斯結婚，本總領事館於1924年12月4日向其簽發第2256號護照。她隨後於1925年3月6日註冊為英國臣民，但此後未再註冊。

當我問及她為何15年來未進行註冊時，她告知我這期間她離開中國去「旅行」，直到今年才回來。若果真如此，我們簽發的護照必定已被另一本護照取代，推測是在其他地方簽發的，因為我們簽發的護照應已於1934年過期。

鑑於本總領事館已長達15年未與奧爾加·史密斯夫人有任何往來，且我個人對其真實性存有疑慮，我認為我們應調查其行蹤，查明她是否仍與史密斯保持婚姻關係並享有英國國籍。據悉她曾受僱於愚園路的喬克酒吧（Jock's Bar），據我了解，去年她可能仍在那裡工作。我印象中她今年也與「百樂門」（Paramount）有關聯。她自稱是藝術家，並向我承認，由於賺錢困難，她正在經營一家「按摩」生意。

/I

G. J. 貝內特先生，
助理處長，
特務科，
上海公共租界工部局警務處，
上海。

奧爾加·阿列克謝耶夫娜·史密斯夫人，波蘭猶太人，因婚姻取得英國國籍，是一名職業？妓女及私會寓所經營者。她是本市「某些圈子」裡的知名人物，因為她在本市經營私會寓所已相當長一段時間。
1924年與已故史密斯先生結婚後，她先離開上海前往馬尼拉，與當地某家夜間歌舞廳有關聯，隨後前往美國。據信她約在10年前回到上海，此後便與各類私會寓所和按摩院有所牽連。
據「某些圈子」謠傳，她與已故史密斯先生的死有關，甚至有人說她毒死了他。
她現在與愚園路238號百樂門大樓（Paramount Bldg.）的一家按摩院有關聯，同時也是其老友、俄羅斯人亞歷山德拉·伊万諾夫娜·米哈伊洛娃夫人（Mrs. Alexandra Ivanovna MIHAILOVA）在南京路138號202室經營的私會寓所的合夥人，電話：10076。

ported to have died in or about 1926.

tish Consulate-General passport No.2256. She has not
been at the Consulate for registration since 6-3-25.

Mrs Smith is not known at the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

While in Shanghai she did not come to the no-
tice of the Municipal Police or of the French Police in
connection with any activities of an undesirable nature.

attached report dated 17-2-39 it may be mentioned that
the New Jock's Bar, 1475 Yu Yuen Road, is reported to be
operated in conjunction with what appears to be a Chi-
nese brothel. The fact that Mrs Smith accepted em-
ployment as a manageress in this establishment seems to
be suggestive of her character generally.

Subject Inquiries re Mrs. Smith.

Made by D.S.I. Galoobkoff Forwarded by [Signature] C.I.

Sir;

I beg to report that enquiries made re-above female show
that she is Russian by birth, and British subject by marriage.
Her former husband late Mr. P.A.W. Smith had been connected with
the firm of Hall & Holtz in Shanghai. After his death Mrs. Smith
has worked as a hostess in cabarets and in 1937 was employed as
a manageress of the Hungarian Restaurant, 272 Yu Yuen Road, when
the same was Chinese owned. When the above restaurant was taken
over by the present owner, Mrs. Smith was discharged on account
of excessive drinking. She then again went to work as a hostess
in a cabaret in Rue Chu Pao San, but later accepted employment
as a manageress of the Jock's Bar, Yu Yuen Road.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. S. I.

D.C. G.B.V.
